decks.notes: The deck is focused on assembling a specific combination of cards, known as the Doomsday pile, to win the game. It uses cards like Demonic Consultation, Vampiric Tutor, and Demonic Tutor to search for key cards. The goal is to cast Doomsday and create a stack of cards that allows the player to win the game with Thassa's Oracle, either by immediately drawing the required cards or by manipulating the library with cards like Dig Through Time and Time Walk. The deck also includes a variety of control elements, counterspells, and draw spells to protect the combo and maintain consistency.

The deck relies on quickly filling the graveyard with cards like Basking Rootwalla and Squee, Goblin Nabob, in order to cheat powerful creatures like Vengevine and Hollow One into play. Utilizing cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Noxious Revival, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with aggressive creatures early in the game. Cards like Force of Will and Mindbreak Trap provide protection, while cards like Force of Vigor and Master of Death offer additional utility. The deck seeks to be fast, relentless, and disruptive, aiming to win the game before the opponent has a chance to establish a strong board presence.

This deck focuses on assembling the Coveted Jewel combo as quickly as possible to gain a significant advantage over the opponent. The key strategy involves utilizing cards like Grim Monolith, Phyrexian Metamorph, and Paradoxical Outcome to generate mana and draw cards, while also having cards like Tinker, Time Vault, and Karn, the Great Creator to help set up the win condition. The inclusion of powerful mana artifacts like Moxen and Mishra's Workshop helps to ramp up quickly and overwhelm the opponent. The deck aims to control the game while setting up for a game-ending play with Coveted Jewel.

The deck focuses on using hatebears like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Chancellor of the Annex to disrupt the opponent's strategy, while also utilizing powerful creatures like Archon of Emeria and Solitude to apply pressure. The deck also includes cards like Trinisphere and Wasteland to further disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base is designed to support these disruptive creatures and spells, with Moxes and Ancient Tomb providing additional acceleration. The goal is to attack the opponent's resources and slow them down while presenting a clock with efficient creatures.

The deck revolves around using Oath of Druids to cheat powerful creatures into play quickly, while also having control elements like Show and Tell, Force of Will, and Flusterstorm to disrupt the opponent's plans. The inclusion of cards like Oko, Thief of Crowns and Bolas's Citadel provide additional value and win conditions. The deck aims to quickly establish board control and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats before they can mount a defense. It combines elements of control and combo strategies to create a versatile and unpredictable game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana and locking down the opponent's resources to overwhelm them with powerful artifacts like Wurmcoil Engine and Golos, Tireless Pilgrim. The deck also includes key artifacts like Time Vault and The One Ring for additional win conditions. The goal is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Sphere of Resistance and Trinisphere, while also generating value with Mishra's Workshop and Inventors' Fair to consistently put pressure on the opponent and close out the game quickly.

The main focus of the deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by using hatebear creatures like Thalia and Chancellor of the Annex to slow down their spells, while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Archon of Emeria and White Plume Adventurer. The deck also includes powerful mana denial cards like Wasteland and Strip Mine to further disrupt the opponent's resources. By combining aggressive creatures with disruptive elements, the deck aims to establish board control and overwhelm the opponent before they can execute their strategy effectively.

This deck focuses on quickly getting creatures onto the battlefield by using cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Serum Powder to draw into key pieces. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Vengevine, Hollow One, and Blazing Rootwalla while disrupting their game plan with cards like Force of Will and Mindbreak Trap. The deck also includes ways to protect its own creatures and disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Force of Negation and Force of Vigor. The strategy is to be fast and relentless, taking advantage of the graveyard and disrupting the opponent's plans.

This deck focuses on generating a lot of mana quickly and efficiently through cards like Tolarian Academy, Grim Monolith, and Mox Opal. The main goal is to ramp up to playing Coveted Jewel, a powerful artifact that can generate massive card advantage and help close out the game. The deck also includes cards like Paradoxical Outcome and Trinisphere to further disrupt the opponent's game plan and protect its own win condition. The end goal is to assemble a powerful board state and overwhelm the opponent with card advantage and mana advantage.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures while disrupting the opponent's game plan with hate cards like Thalia, Chancellor of the Annex, and Trinisphere. It aims to slow down the opponent's plays by taxing their spells and making it difficult for them to cast multiple spells per turn. It also utilizes powerful mana acceleration like Chrome Mox and Ancient Tomb to quickly deploy threats like Archon of Emeria and Solitude. The deck's strategy revolves around applying pressure while stifling the opponent's resources, ultimately aiming to overwhelm them before they can establish their own game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through a combination of powerful spells and card advantage while utilizing the Oath of Druids to cheat big creatures into play. The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm, while also using cards like Show and Tell and Tinker to quickly put threats on the board. Additionally, the deck includes card draw and selection spells like Brainstorm and Ancestral Recall to ensure consistency and find key pieces. The goal is to set up a strong board presence and outvalue the opponent while maintaining control of the game.

The key concept of the deck is to establish control over the game through the use of planeswalkers and disruptive spells. The deck aims to control the opponent's resources and strategies by utilizing powerful cards like Wasteland, Force of Will, and Strip Mine to disrupt their mana base. Additionally, the deck includes a variety of powerful planeswalkers like Dack Fayden, Oko, Thief of Crowns, and Narset, Parter of Veils to further control the game and gain card advantage. The inclusion of powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Minsc & Boo, Timeless Heroes provide additional threats and value.

The key concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's plays with cards like Trinisphere, Chalice of the Void, Sphere of Resistance, and Null Rod, while also utilizing MUD (mono brown) artifacts to generate fast mana and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Lodestone Golem, Phyrexian Revoker, and Patchwork Automaton. The deck aims to control the board and mana production through land destruction with Strip Mine and Wasteland, and gain value through recursion with Crucible of Worlds. Overall, the deck aims to quickly establish dominance and close out the game before the opponent can respond effectively.

The main idea of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by playing hatebears like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Chancellor of the Annex, while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Solitude and Archon of Emeria. The deck also includes cards like Loran of the Third Path to generate value and protect its creatures. With a focus on disrupting and slowing down the opponent's strategy while maintaining pressure, this deck aims to control the game and secure a win through attrition and efficient beatdown tactics. By utilizing powerful hatebears and aggressive creatures, this deck creates a challenging board state for the opponent to navigate.

This deck revolves around using Underworld Breach to repeatedly cast powerful spells from the graveyard, fueled by a combination of cantrips, tutors, and fast mana. The goal is to assemble the combo quickly while controlling the opponent's game plan with disruptive spells like Force of Will and Pyroblast. Lurrus of the Dream-Den provides additional value by allowing you to recur key cards from the graveyard. The deck seeks to win the game through a combination of card advantage, efficiency, and explosive plays enabled by the combo potential of Underworld Breach.

The deck focuses on quickly establishing control through powerful cards like Show and Tell and Oath of Druids to cheat out big threats. It utilizes a combination of powerful artifacts, spells, and planeswalkers to disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up a win condition. The deck aims to quickly set up a dominating board presence and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats and disruptive spells. The mana base is designed to support this game plan efficiently, providing the necessary colors and acceleration to consistently execute the strategy.
